evidence_items.locator: Abstract, page 1; results on pages 4–6; testing dates in section 4.2
evidence_items.explanation: Testing of gpt-3.5-turbo ran from April 16 through May 2, 2023. With the binary prompt, it correctly classified 80% of clearly true claims and about 69% of clearly false claims, demonstrating discrimination of both classes; the reported aggregate excludes refusals and groups partially true labels.

FELM found severe limitations when models assessed factual errors in generated responses. This is material counterevidence to any claim of dependable verification, but task-specific failures do not establish the blanket absence of capability tested by the contract.
